verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an App API for fetching data, with an OpenAPI spec confirmed by probe. Its CLI exposes the Journeys UI API with structured JSON output, and the AI/MCP tooling can report on message performance, so performance data appears reachable programmatically. However, nothing explicitly documents campaign or flow metrics endpoints, or a metrics export to a warehouse; the warehouse integration described is reverse ETL into Customer.io. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of campaign/journey metrics endpoints, a documented metrics export path to a warehouse or BI tool, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
